requirements.quote: "All the smart meter makes shall have all the valid test certificates (issued within the last 5 years) and BIS certificate, compliant to IS 16444 Part-1 as on the date of application."
requirements.text: Smart meters must have valid test certificates and BIS certification compliant with IS 16444 Part-1.

requirements.quote: "Meter manufacturer / supplier should have a valid ISO 9001:2015 certification as on the date of application."
requirements.text: Meter manufacturers must have ISO 9001:2015 certification.

requirements.quote: "The TP should have experience in manufacturing and supply of 50000 Nos of Smart Energy Meters/Pre-Paid Meters to Indian or Global company in last 3 Years."
requirements.text: The bidder must have experience in manufacturing and supplying 50,000 smart/pre-paid meters in the last 3 years.

requirements.quote: "Proposed HES should have been integrated with at least one MDMS/ other utility IT solutions in Indian/ Global Utility(ies) as on the date of application."
requirements.text: The proposed HES must be integrated with at least one MDMS or utility IT solution.

requirements.quote: "Proposed MDMS should have been integrated with at least One HES solutions in Indian/ Global Utility(ies) as on the date of application."
requirements.text: The proposed MDMS must be integrated with at least one HES solution.

requirements.quote: "Proposed MDMS should have been integrated with at least one Billing systems in Indian/ Global Utility(ies) or with Billing/ other IT systems of at least one Indian/Global Utility(ies) as on the date of application."
requirements.text: The proposed MDMS must integrate with at least one billing system or IT system.

requirements.quote: "MDMS solution provider should have a valid CMMI Level-3 or IEC/ISO27001."
requirements.text: The MDMS provider must have CMMI Level-3 or IEC/ISO27001 certification.
